opengmaps.name: OpenGMaps v0.1.0 keyed (debug)
opengmaps.body:
Debug-signed HAP with working Google Maps Platform keys baked in (verified on OpenHarmony 5.0.1 emulator: real map tiles, live search + place cards, directions route).

Keys used (one per surface, via dart-define):
- GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY = Places key
- OGM_MAPS_KEY = Maps JavaScript key
- OGM_GEO_KEY / OGM_DIRS_KEY = Geocoding + Directions key

Built from commit f065b65 (`feat: per-service Google Maps API keys via dart-define`).

ohemacs.name: OHEmacs v0.1.0 - Initial Public Release
ohemacs.body:
First official release of OHEmacs, bringing GNU Emacs 30.1 to OpenHarmony and HarmonyOS devices with both a desktop-faithful GUI and a standalone native aarch64 terminal CLI.

Highlights:
- Standalone native aarch64 terminal CLI (/data/local/tmp/emacs) supporting interactive TUI and --batch evaluation
- Desktop-faithful GUI with classic menu bar, toolbar, tab bar, and syntax highlighting
- Stage 2 Native EGL Surface via XComponent + NAPI bridge
- Stage 2 Verification Suite: 15/15 PASS

assets.name: emacs-cli-aarch64
assets.label: Native Terminal CLI Binary (aarch64 ELF)
assets.installHint: hdc file send emacs-cli-aarch64 /data/local/tmp/emacs && hdc shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/emacs

whatisit.name: WhatIsIt (Current Source & Companion Server)
whatisit.body: Native ArkUI WhatsApp client with Go companion server (whatsmeow + meowcaller, SQLite). Link once via in-app QR code or 8-char phone code; the companion server keeps the Multi-Device WhatsApp session alive. Automated GitHub Releases pending; source code and server daemon are immediately buildable.

assets.name: whatisit-main.zip
assets.label: Full Source Code & Go Server (main branch)
assets.installHint: unzip main.zip && cd WhatIsIt-main/server-go && go run ./cmd/server

opentwit.name: OpenTwit (Current Source)
opentwit.body: Native ArkTS X client for HarmonyOS (Stage model, phone / tablet / 2in1). Home timeline, Explore, Alerts, DMs and Me tabs with OAuth 2.0 PKCE sign-in. Automated GitHub Releases pending; the v1.0.0 source tree builds today via hvigor.

opentwit-web.name: OpenTwit-Web 1.0.0 — native HarmonyOS shell (signed)
opentwit-web.body:
The real x.com web app inside a fully native HarmonyOS shell — and this time it is signed.

What ships in this release:
- Full web Twitter (home, explore, notifications, messages, profile, settings) in the system Web component, signed in with web cookies — no API key
- Native chrome: per-tab headers, Home 'For you / Following' switcher that drives the page's own timeline tab, Explore header search, account menu, compose FAB + bottom sheet, native toast
- Bottom tab bar with filled HarmonyOS Symbols that becomes a side rail past 840 vp — phone, tablet, unfolded foldable and 2in1 from a single HAP
- X's own nav, page headers and floating compose button stripped by injected CSS/JS so the shell never double-renders chrome
- Route-aware user agent, offline retry card, render-process recovery, haptic tick on tab change
- Guideline audit, layered app icon and en / zh_CN string resources in docs/HARMONY_GUIDELINE_AUDIT.md
